bullets.title: MRVL: Monster Investor Day — PT upgrades flood in, FY31 target $70-90B revenue / $30+ EPS
bullets.body: Marvell's Investor Day raised FY28 revenue guidance to ~$20B (from ~$18B), introduced FY31 target of $70-90B revenue and >$30 EPS (~60% CAGR), with custom XPU revenues >$12B in FY29 (3x YoY) and interconnect TAM growing 65% annually to $65B by CY30. PT upgrades: Oppenheimer to $425, Piper to $400, JPM to $360, Wolfe to $375, UBS to $350, TD Cowen upgrade to Buy at $350, Roth maintains Buy at $350. GS remains Neutral at 9.5x FY31 EPS; MS stays Equal-Weight. Optical/comms ecosystem ripped on MRVL interconnect commentary (CIEN +13.8%, ALAB +7.6%, MTSI +6.8%).

bullets.title: NVDA: SpaceX raising $40B to buy Rubin chips; AI compute demand narrative reinforced
bullets.body: SpaceX is seeking ~$40B in financing ($10B bank loans + $30B investment-grade debt led by Apollo) exclusively to purchase Nvidia chips, with deal expected to close in 2027. Multiple sources note this validates insatiable AI compute demand but raise concerns about circularity in Nvidia's funding ecosystem and collateral quality. SpaceX 2056 bonds trading at ~$0.85, indicating financial stress.

bullets.title: MSFT: Azure VM/Storage prices rising 17-25% globally starting Feb 1
bullets.body: Microsoft is raising Azure VM and Storage prices 17% in Europe and 25% worldwide for legacy v1/v2 configurations starting February 1, following similar moves by AWS and neoclouds (NBIS, CRWV). Yorkville Ives initiates MSFT at Outperform with $615 PT.

bullets.title: Yorkville Ives mass initiation: AAPL $400, NVDA $300, TSLA $500, META $900, NFLX in-line $75
bullets.body: New firm Yorkville Ives initiated broad mega-cap tech coverage: AAPL Outperform $400 (+20%), AMZN $300, GOOGL $400, META $900, MSFT $615, NVDA $300, TSLA $500, PLTR $250, SNOW $400, CRM $290, MDB $430, NOW $160 — all Outperform. NFLX initiated In-Line at $75; ORCL In-Line at $155.

bullets.title: MU: Taiwan union votes to authorize strike; DA Davidson maintains Buy as acquisition target
bullets.body: Micron's Taoyuan union (1,994 members, ~15K total Taiwan employees) voted 99% to authorize a strike over bonus scheme dispute; union encouraging members to take off October 19 but has not formally called a strike, hoping for a profit-sharing proposal before then. DA Davidson maintains Buy with thesis that Micron is an acquisition target.

bullets.title: GOOGL/CEG: 890 MW new nuclear + 2,700 MW existing capacity deal with 20-year PPA; $2.50/share EPS upside for CEG
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley estimates the CEG-GOOGL nuclear deal (890 MW new nuclear + 2,700 MW existing capacity in PJM, first uprates in 2028, ~$80/MWh pricing) adds ~$2.50/share EPS and ~$800M FCF for CEG. MS raises CEG PT to $369. GOOGL's Waymo H1 2026 miles were ~3% below forecast on weather/recall issues, but 2032E miles raised +2% as new cities launch ahead of schedule; Waymo on track for ~$20B revenue by 2032.

bullets.title: ZS: Investor Day sets $8B+ FY31 ARR target (17% CAGR); UBS raises PT to $250, KeyBanc bullish
bullets.body: Zscaler introduced >$8B organic ARR target by FY31 (17% CAGR) with a $10B upside case (22% CAGR), well ahead of prior street estimates. FY31 margin targets: 80% gross, 27-30% operating, 29-32% FCF. UBS raised PT to $250; KeyBanc PT $210 (trading at 8x EV/Sales CY27E). GTM disruptions and CRO transition remain execution risks; management reaffirmed FQ1 & FY27 guidance.

bullets.title: RBLX: MS upgrades to Overweight $55 PT on AI game creation; Unity-Google partnership a near-term headwind
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley raised RBLX to Overweight with $55 PT, citing Build tool (>100K beta users, 71% never used Roblox Studio before) democratizing game creation via natural-language prompts. Separately, RBLX fell ~4.6% in pre-market after Unity Software partnered with Google on an AI gaming platform (Playground + Unity Spark), seen as competitive threat.

bullets.title: NFLX: JPM flags crowded short with 24% PT upside; Yorkville in-line at $75
bullets.body: JPM notes NFLX is one of the most crowded shorts in Internet/Media despite 24% upside to its $85 PT. Investor sentiment is cautious on lack of hit content and declining daily time spent (~1.5h/day from ~2h). Hedgeye signals NFLX as Bearish trend with range $66-71. Yorkville initiates In-Line at $75.

bullets.title: AAPL: Smart home devices (doorbell, lock, thermostat) with LG launching October 13
bullets.body: Multiple sources confirm Apple is launching a smart home product lineup (doorbell, lock, thermostat) developed in partnership with LG, debuting October 13. AAPL +1.2% pre-market following Yorkville Ives Outperform initiation at $400 PT. Hedgeye signals AAPL Bullish with buy range $327-342.

bullets.title: AMD: Samsung partnership exploration ongoing; needs HBM4 for MI455X; signals supply increase in 2027
bullets.body: AMD CEO is continuing to explore partnership opportunities with Samsung and SK Hynix on memory (HBM4 qualification needed for MI455X) and has signaled the company will 'substantially increase' chip supply in 2027 to meet AI demand. AAOI down 2.2% pre-market on the Samsung partnership news.

bullets.title: TSLA/INTC: Musk confirms Tesla/SpaceX builds Terafab; TSMC limited to potential sublease only
bullets.body: Musk clarified that his companies (Tesla/SpaceX) will build and operate Terafab, with TSMC potentially subleasing a portion only — not operating as an equal partner. TSMC fell ~4% in pre-market on the news. Intel CEO confirmed Intel remains the active manufacturing partner via 14A process ($16.8B initial commitment, up to $119B total). Hedgeye signals TSLA upgraded to Bullish trend.

bullets.title: SNAP: Blue Duck Capital activist proposes Specs spin at $5B post-money; campaign expected to fail
bullets.body: JPM notes a new SNAP activist (Blue Duck Capital) proposing to raise external capital for dedicated Specs at $5B post-money valuation, valuing core ads business at 2-3.5x EV/2027E EBITDA (~$2B). Despite mid-to-high teens topline growth and ~1B monthly users, the campaign is expected to fail given Evan Spiegel's past resistance to such proposals.

bullets.title: HUBS: 7% RIF (~660 employees) saves ~$126M annualized; market indifferent, watching revenue reaccel
bullets.body: HubSpot cut 7% of workforce (~660 employees, ~$126M annualized opex savings based on ~$191K median comp). JPM and others note the market is largely ignoring the RIF and focusing on revenue reacceleration. Company reaffirmed Q3 and full-year guidance. APP downgraded to Neutral at UBS after ~40% recovery from June lows.

bullets.title: META: Personal Agent Protocol launch with WMT, SHOP, Stripe; Muse AI disintermediation risk to banks
bullets.body: META launched Personal Agent Protocol (PAP) with Walmart, Shopify, and Stripe for agentic commerce, with v0.1 coming late October; Adyen, PayPal also testing checkout within Meta AI. Separately, META's Muse AI agent (6.6M+ downloads, 1.8M DAUs) is flagged as a deposit-stickiness risk for banks by automating subscription cancellations and yield-chasing. Citi has META Buy-rated with $900 PT average 43% upside.

bullets.title: STX/WDC: Toshiba reportedly bidding for TDK HDD-head business; supply risk concerns overdone per MS
bullets.body: STX and Toshiba are reportedly bidding for TDK's magnetic-head business. Morgan Stanley argues the TDK acquisition is unlikely to accelerate Toshiba expansion or create meaningful supply risk for STX/WDC, and sees 2:1 to 3:1 risk/reward skew in STX/WDC post 10-15% drawdowns, though the re-rating path is longer.

bullets.title: CIEN: Wolfe Outperform $660 PT (49% upside) as MRVL Investor Day validates coherent module TAM 3x by FY31
bullets.body: Wolfe maintains Outperform on CIEN with $660 PT (22x CY28 EPS of $20.11), citing Marvell's forecast that coherent module unit TAM grows from ~1M today to >3M units by FY31 and DCI sales rising from ~$500M in FY26 to multiple billions by FY29-31. CIEN surged +13.8% on MRVL's interconnect commentary.

bullets.title: AAOI: Hedgeye long with 38% upside on AI optics tailwinds and internal laser production advantage
bullets.body: Hedgeye is long AAOI at 2027 4x EV/Sales and 2028 2.5x EV/Sales, citing >200% growth potential in 2027 driven by 800G/1.6T pluggable life extension and AI supply constraints. Despite inferior laser tech vs COHR/LITE, AAOI's internal InP substrate production is a key advantage amid industry shortages. Pre-market AAOI -4.5% in sympathy with broader semicap weakness.

bullets.title: T: AT&T forms wholesale fiber JV with GIP and CPP, targeting 60M addresses by 2030
bullets.body: AT&T announced a new wholesale fiber JV combining Forged Fiber 37 (Lumen-acquired assets) and Gigapower with Global Infrastructure Partners and CPP Investments; AT&T retains 50% stake. JV launches with ~5M fiber locations and >1M AT&T Fiber subscribers across 16 states, targeting 60M addresses by end-2030, with close expected H1 2027.

bullets.title: Macro: 10-yr yield +5-6 bps to ~5.33%; S&P/Nasdaq at ATHs but weak breadth; AI capex ROIC debate intensifies
bullets.body: The 10-year UST yield hit 5.33-5.34% (highest since 2002) with futures pricing ~1 hike in 2026 and 2x in 2027; S&P 500 and Nasdaq hit record ATHs but Russell 2000 remains in a -7.8% drawdown. Investors require $400-600B AI frontier-lab ARR by end-2027 to justify hyperscaler capex through 2028-29; hyperscaler bond issuance now represents 14% of net new Treasury borrowing. BofA flags growing tech bubble risk but advises staying invested via call spreads.
